pattern: Headed lists: a named group (the board) containing column headings and, with swimlanes, labelled sections; each cell is a named list (role=list) of focusable list items (cards) with aria-posinset and aria-setsize. One roving tab stop covers all cards; arrow keys move between cards and columns. Moves follow the Sortable List grab-and-move model (Space picks up, arrows move, Space drops, Escape cancels) with live-region announcements, plus a single-pointer path through the toolbar (WCAG 2.5.7). No deprecated ARIA drag-and-drop attributes.

roles.role: heading (aria-level = headingLevel), text: name and count

roles.element: column handle, column toggle, lane toggle, toolbar buttons

roles.role: listitem, focusable, described by the instructions

aria.value: Position in its cell and the cell size (also in virtual cells)
true while its move is saved
true while a card is picked / the column is picked up
true when Move, Undo, or Redo is not possible (buttons stay focusable)
0 on the roving card, -1 on the others
Assertive: picked up, each keyboard move ('{column}, position 2 of 5'), dropped, cancelled, refused (locked, full column), save failed. Polite: undone, redone.

keyboard.action: Toolbar buttons, column handles and toggles, swimlane toggles, then one tab stop for the cards.
Next / previous card in the cell; past the end, the first (last) card of the same column in the next (previous) swimlane.
The card at the same position (or the last one) in the next non-empty expanded column of the swimlane.
First / last card of the cell; with Ctrl, of the board.
Pick the card up (refused and announced for locked cards and cards being saved).
Move one position; past the edges into the previous / next swimlane.
Move to the adjacent expanded column that accepts it (full columns under 'block', locked columns, and canMove vetoes are skipped).
Move to the first / last position of the cell.
Cancel; the card returns (Escape does not close an enclosing overlay).

keyboard.key: Space or Enter, ArrowLeft / ArrowRight, Home / End, Space or Enter, Escape
keyboard.action: Pick the column up, move it, drop it, or cancel.

focus: One roving tab stop over the cards (the last focused card, else the first). A picked-up card keeps focus while it moves (it is re-focused after each re-render). After a drop or undo, focus stays on the card. Collapsing a column or swimlane moves the roving stop to the first visible card. Virtual cells keep the focused card rendered; if it scrolls out, focus moves to the first card in view.
wcag: 1.4.10 Reflow (two-dimensional board scrolls in its own container)
notes: WIP state is text ('3 of 5', 'Over limit'), not color alone.
Locked and saving states are part of the card text (', Locked', ', Saving').
The single-pointer path: select a card, press Move, then click a card (to place it before) or an empty part of a cell (to place it last).
knownCaveats: Pointer drags are announced at pick-up and drop only.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
